name: DEAR
notes: Kind hadron_structure is the nearest Atlas kind for kaonic-atom (low-energy QCD) physics at an e+e- collider.
Franzini & Moulson call DEAR 'literally a tabletop experiment': it shared the second DAΦNE interaction point with FINUDA and could be assembled when FINUDA was retracted.

physics_goals.quote: has the goal of measuring the isospin dependent antikaon-nucleon scattering lengths
physics_goals.value: Kaonic hydrogen (and deuterium) X-ray spectroscopy: the isospin-dependent antikaon-nucleon scattering lengths from the shift and width of the Kα line

summary.plain: A tabletop experiment at Frascati's DAΦNE that stopped kaons in a hydrogen gas target and measured the X-rays from kaonic hydrogen, an exotic atom with a kaon in place of the electron. It ran in 2002 and gave the most precise values then known of how the strong force shifts the atom's lowest level.
summary.technical: DEAR (DAΦNE Exotic Atom Research): pressurised cryogenic gas-target cell (11 cm diameter, 75 µm kapton wall) with 16 CCD-55 X-ray detectors at the second DAΦNE interaction point; test runs 2000-2001, physics data 2002 (kaonic nitrogen, then 58.4 pb⁻¹ on hydrogen); kaonic hydrogen 1s shift ε = −193 ± 37 ± 6 eV and width Γ = 249 ± 111 ± 30 eV (Phys. Rev. Lett. 94, 212302). Upgraded to SIDDHARTA.
